jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.

As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.

 
 

What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:

  • Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

  • Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.

  • Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.

  • Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.

  • Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.

  • Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.

  • Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.

  • Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.

  • Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.

  • Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.

  • Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.

  • Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • 4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.

  • A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.

  • Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.

  • A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.

  • Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.

  • Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.



As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.

 
 

What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:

 - Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

 - Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

 - Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.

 - Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.

 - Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.

 - Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.

 - Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.

 - Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.

 - Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.

 - Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.

 - Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.

 - Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.

 - Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.

 - Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

 - Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.



How to be successful in this role:

 - 10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

 - 4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

 - Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.

 - A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.

 - Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.

 - A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.

 - Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.

 - Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

 - Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

 - A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.

 - A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

 - Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

 - Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

 - Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale.

Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta’s growth.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

The Integrations Platform team mission is to power the world’s largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly. We own Vanta’s integration ecosystem, which currently includes over 400 integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information System (HRIS). We are focused on developing the Integration Platform. This includes creating shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing to ensure all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely. We aim to enable anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI Agents.

What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Set technical strategy and direction for critical platform surface areas, staying ahead of rapid growth.

  • Design and evolve the APIs, primitives, and self-service golden paths that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.

  • Own the authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution primitives that keep integrations with external systems secure and reliable at scale.

  • Build secure, well-documented, scalable backend services and developer tooling (including CI/CD) that propel engineering productivity.

  • Drive performance, operational excellence, and SDLC best practices; make and defend buy-vs-build and one-way-door decisions.

  • Act as a force multiplier: mentor and uplevel teammates, and set the design patterns the team standardizes on.

  • Build with TypeScript, React, and Node.js, and use AI tools to accelerate development and workflows.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of backend development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

  • Platform and API design: you've evolved core APIs, SDKs, and platform abstractions, with deep expertise in RESTful APIs, GraphQL, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.

  • Data Integrations: you've built resilient data ingestion from external systems, including integrations with cloud providers, HRIS platforms, identity providers, and code repositories. You champion best practices such as rate limiting, retries and idempotency, webhooks, and handling schema drift.

  • Systems thinking at scale: you design for scale, reliability and failure modes. You look around corners and proactively identify and address risk.

  • Technical leadership and cross-team influence: you've led teams and complex projects, and influenced decisions across the organization.

  • Internal Enablement and Evangelism: you build sample integrations, POCs, AI Skills, documentation, and workshops to help internal engineering teams onboard quickly to the platform.

Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, greenfield work, multi-region or Gov deployments, and prior experience in security or compliance products.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Pension contribution

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Flexible work hours and location

  • 21 days of Vacation Time and 80 hours of Sick Leave

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. The Vanta for Government team is building and evolving Vanta's AI-powered platform for government vendors, federal agencies, and State, Local, and Education (SLED) organizations.   • Partner with adjacent engineering teams on shared infrastructure and tagging systems that underpin government-specific compliance workflows, building on existing platform investments rather than starting from scratch

  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, 0→1 environments where requirements evolve as you learn from customers and technical decisions carry real business consequences

jobs.title: Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The team owns the operational strategy and execution of our mid-to-late GTM Sales motion for the NAMER Upmarket organization, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. We build and evolve the sales processes, workflows, data, and policies that enable sellers to effectively manage opportunities, navigate complex deals, and convert pipeline into predictable revenue.

Our work spans opportunity management, forecasting, complex deal strategy and structuring, contracting workflows, and Rules of Engagement. We work hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate critical deals and day-to-day business challenges, while identifying where broader processes, policies, data, or systems need to evolve. We partner closely across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other GTM teams to improve seller effectiveness, sales efficiency, conversion, and revenue predictability as the business scales.

What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and day to day operations for the Upmarket mid-to-late sales funnel, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. Develop a strong point of view on the sales processes, stage management, opportunity management, workflows, and seller behaviors needed to improve conversion, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth.

  • Own and evolve the operational workflows and data that support contracting and complex deal execution, ensuring sellers have clear, scalable paths from opportunity through contract and close. Serve as a go-to strategic and operational partner for creative and complex deal structures, working hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate non-standard scenarios while partnering closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Use insights from individual deals to identify recurring friction and drive improvements to the processes, policies, data, and systems that enable the business to close effectively at scale.

  • Shape deal strategy and the operational processes that support complex sales motions, partnering with sellers, Sales leadership, Deal Desk, Finance, and other teams to navigate complex opportunities while identifying where broader process, policy, or system changes can make it easier and more effective to close business at scale.

  • Evolve the Rules of Engagement and the cross-functional policies that govern how GTM teams work together throughout the sales cycle, bringing clarity to ownership, handoffs, deal scenarios, and areas of competing priorities. Lead alignment across Sales and other GTM organizations as our sales motions and business needs evolve.

  • Own and evolve sales forecast cadences, facilitating forecast reviews with Sales leadership to scrutinize pipeline health and deal-specific risks.

  • Identify and lead strategic improvements to our mid-to-late funnel operating model, using data, field insights, and deep sales process expertise to diagnose where opportunities are getting stuck or where seller effectiveness can improve. Lead complex initiatives from problem definition and recommendation through senior stakeholder alignment, hands-on implementation, and measurement of business impact in partnership with GTM Systems & Analytics and other cross-functional teams.

How to be successful in this role:

Our Software Engineers build and own high-value products for our customers and the infrastructure that lets our business scale.

Vanta's team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it's essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to scale with our business. As a Software Engineer, you'll build and own full-stack features and platform primitives across our stack, work closely with the teams and partners who depend on what you ship, and grow into broader technical ownership. Your work will directly accelerate Vanta's growth.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

The Integrations Platform team within Vanta Government Cloud mission is to power the world's largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly.

Federal compliance is going through its biggest shift in a decade and this team builds the integration platform underneath Vanta Government Cloud that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. This is a builder role: you'll turn federal control requirements into the platform primitives and integrations that make continuous authorization real.

We own Vanta's integration ecosystem within the US Government Cloud, which currently includes a growing set of integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS). In this role, you'll build, own, support, and scale Vanta's Government Cloud integration operations. You'll build upon and extend the Integrations Platform, which includes shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing so that all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely, enabling anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI agents.

What you’ll do as a Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Design, build, and own full-stack features and platform primitives that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.

  • Deploy, operate, support, and maintain integrations running in Vanta's Government Cloud, including monitoring, on-call / incident response, and change management within the GovCloud boundary.

  • Contribute to our authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution services, keeping integrations with external systems secure and reliable.

  • Partner with federal subject-matter experts to implement and maintain continuous-monitoring detectors and automated tests, with versioned framework mappings.

  • Build secure, well-documented, scalable services and UI with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Improve performance, operational excellence, and SDLC practices within the team.

  • Use AI tools and workflows to accelerate development and operations.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 6+ years of full-stack development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

  • Platform and API design: you've built APIs and reusable components others depend on, with a solid grounding in RESTful APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.

  • Data integrations: you've built data ingestion from external systems (Cloud Providers, HRIS, Identity Providers, Code Repositories) using best practices like rate limiting, retries and idempotency, and webhooks.

  • Systems thinking: you design for scale, reliability, and failure modes. You look around corners, address edge cases, and proactively identify and address risk.

  • Collaboration: you partner with internal teams, Federal agencies employees, vendors, and Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAOs) to achieve mutual success. You incorporate their feedback into your designs, and are on a clear trajectory to broader technical ownership.

  • Interest in security or compliance: you're motivated by building trustworthy systems in a regulated environment.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Requirements

  • Physical location: you must reside in, and perform all work exclusively from within, the United States, accessing systems only from U.S. locations.

  • Work Authorization Requirements: You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, FISMA) and how they apply to cloud and integration environments.

  • Experience building or operating in a government or otherwise regulated cloud environment (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or GCP) — deep familiarity with one translates well to the others.

Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, and interest in security or compliance products

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.



Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on!



The Authoring Experience team owns how Vanta tests are authored and deployed to customers, from the APIs and services underneath to the experiences built on top. As a Senior Backend Engineer on this team, you will own the services and public-facing customer APIs that turn Vanta's automation platform into products customers touch directly, stitching together systems across the platform to serve them well.



What you’ll do as a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the architecture and rollout strategy for critical platform services, from initial design through large-scale rollout and migration.

 - Set the technical bar for how we design, publish, and maintain customer-facing APIs while owning things like security, reliability, and developer experience.

 - Stitch together services across Vanta's platform to serve customer-facing use cases, designing clear service boundaries and partnering closely with our data-platform teams on access patterns.

 - Raise the written design bar: drive RFCs and decision records that make architectural decisions durable and shared across the team.

 - Act as a force multiplier: mentor engineers up to your own level, expand the team's review capacity, and partner with your EM on team health and culture.

 - Build with TypeScript and Node.js on the backend, contribute to customer-facing experiences in React, and use AI tools to accelerate development and workflows.



How to be successful in this role:

 - 8+ years of backend development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

 - You've designed and shipped external or public product APIs: contracts, versioning, authentication, and the developer experience around them.

 - You think in service boundaries and system design rather than any single layer of the stack, with enough data-layer fluency to partner well with dedicated platform teams.

 - You're comfortable working in a modern frontend codebase (we use React); you don't need to be an expert, but building product end to end is part of the day-to-day here.

 - Track record driving complex, ambiguous, multi-quarter initiatives to completion, directly and through others.

 - Experience rolling out or deprecating major systems safely at scale.

 - Strong written design communication and demonstrated mentorship; you multiply the engineers around you.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, MongoDB at scale, prior work in security or compliance products.



Requirements

 - Physical location: you must reside in, and perform all work exclusively from within, the United States, accessing systems only from U.S. locations.

 - Work Authorization Requirements: You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. 



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Systems Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Financial Systems Engineer at Vanta, you will own the end-to-end health and evolution of the tech stack, data, and system integrations across our Procure to Pay and FP&A verticals, and be a technical lead for procurement, planning, and finance data systems.

Vanta's Financial Systems function builds, maintains, and supports the tools that Vanta's Finance & Accounting operate on. The team builds scalable, integrated, and high value solutions that enable Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to move quickly without trading away accuracy or auditability.

Vanta's Finance Systems team is early, and Procurement and FP&A have historically had little systems representation. That makes this a rare chance to own foundational decisions rather than inherit them. You will be helping implement our first CPM tool, re-architect Zip end-to-end, and help build the finance data layer in Snowflake that everything downstream will run on, with the autonomy to set the standards the team builds on as we scale.

What you’ll do as a Senior Financial Systems Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the architecture, configuration, and operational health of Zip (P2P) including workflows, integrations, customizations, and agentic buildout

  • Serve as the internal lead implementing Vanta's first CPM tool, working with an implementation partner, and owning the product post-launch

  • Partner with Data/Analytics to design the Finance and Accounting data model in Snowflake, translating FP&A and Accounting requirements into data plans and SQL models

  • Architect and maintain integrations between NetSuite and adjacent systems (Salesforce, Stripe, Anrok, Tesorio, Workato, Zip, Snowflake, Slack) using iPaaS tooling and direct API connections

  • Partner across Procurement, AP, FP&A, Accounting, Legal, GRC, Data / Analytics, and RevOps to turn business needs into durable system solutions

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Financial Systems Analyst/Engineering/Management in a high-growth SaaS environment, including leading projects from requirements gathering to go-live support

  • Deep expertise in the P2P function, as well as the configuration and administration of procurement tools (Zip, Coupa, Ariba, or similar)

  • Proficiency in SQL including being able to write, review, and debug custom scripts end-to-end

  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting CPM tools for FP&A (Adaptive Insights, Pigment, Anaplan, or similar)

  • Experience building and owning multi-system integrations using iPaaS platforms and API endpoints (Workato, Boomi, or similar)

  • Practical understanding of AI governance frameworks (human-in-the-loop, auditability, SOX compliance), with a demonstrated understanding of how and when to embed AI into finance and accounting workflows

  • Strong written communication and design documentation skills

  • Experience with NetSuite and CPQ is a nice to have

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
